items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Roy Evans on banjo... I was on banjo. Joe Robichaux was on piano.

ctx.x: . . . a lot of instruments. That’s right. Good saxophone player. Who else was in that band?
Roy Evans on banjo. That’s all . . . Roy Evans on guitar. Who’s on there on bass? Can’t think. Theodore, David Jones were the reed section.
